messages:
Jules M: Quick lunchtime idea 

Jules M: Pull-up ladder + coffee prize tomorrow? 12:15pm quick set on the pull-up bar by the gym, then coffees for the top 3. Low pressure. Anyone? :muscle::coffee:
Priya R: Ooh Im intrigued. how would the ladder work?
Carlos V: 5 rounds, each round you do one more rep than the last? or just max reps in 2 minutes per person?
Maya S: Can we have a beginner track? assisted pull-ups or ring rows count. want it to be friendly.
Jules M: love the assisted option 

Jules M: plan: warm-up at 12:10, ladder format (1,2,3...) maxing at 5 rounds, then tie-breaker = single max hang. tally points. coffee for top 3. 20min total.
Priya R: works for me. Ill bring a resistance band for assistance. :biceps:
Carlos V: Im in. can someone grab a small whiteboard for scores?
Maya S: Ill bring chalk and a little speaker for music. also yes to assisted track.
Jules M: ok tagging gym-bot to reserve the bar and add a 12:10 event. @gym-bot reserve "Noon Pull-up Ladder (coffee prizes)" 2026-05-12 12:10 -> 12:30
gym-bot: Reservation confirmed: "Noon Pull-up Ladder (coffee prizes)"  12:10-12:30  Location: Rooftop Gym Bar. Invitations sent to Jules M, Priya R, Carlos V, Maya S
Priya R: tiny poll: caffe latte :latte: or cold brew :coffee:? react with :latte: or :coffee:
Carlos V: :coffee:
Maya S: :latte:
Jules M: :coffee: (strongly)
Priya R: cool, two coffees and a latte so far.
Carlos V: if youre remote, you can join the scoreboard thread and post a selfie of your max hang. solidarity points.
Maya S: also posting a quick how-to in case people are new: ring rows, band-assisted pull-ups, negatives. link: https://example.com/pullup-variations
Jules M: awesome. see you tomorrow @ 12:10. winners get bragging rights + coffee coupon. low-stress, high-fun. :tada:
Priya R: pumped. Im focusing on form not ego.
Carlos V: same. may the best (most consistent) back win.
Maya S: bringing tiny victory stickers for winners.
Jules M: perfect. if anyone wants to join last minute, just show up. well run it quick so folks can get back to their day.
